title: Motorola MG7550 Cable Modem + Wi-Fi Router Combo, Black (Open Box)

comparisons.notes: Same model MG7550, in stock, fetched store page

writeup: Woot has an open-box Motorola MG7550 for $25.08, with a limit of two per customer. The MG7550 combines a cable modem and a Wi-Fi router in one unit, so it can replace a rented gateway if your cable provider supports it. Modemguides lists the same model at $96, which makes this about 73% less. Open-box condition, so check your ISP's compatibility list before activating it.
amazon_match_notes: Woot offer data ASIN B01JGT2JI6 matches Motorola MG7550 modem/router combo, black, single unit (open box on Woot)
